title: Mack Superliner Powder Coated FUPS Bullbar #19
description: Mack Superliner hi-tensile powder coated aluminium FUPS Bullbar with contoured main lower bar. Choice of colours available as required. Standard design, 88mm dia, 100mm dia available. Heavy duty tow pin and steel backing plate. Indicator repeaters mounted in main bar. Driving light mounts custom fitted as required.
